biocontainers.name: bioconductor-tapseq
biocontainers.summary: Targeted scrna-seq primer design for tap-seq

biotools.summary: Design primers for targeted single-cell RNA-seq used by TAP-seq. Create sequence templates for target gene panels and design gene-specific primers using Primer3. Potential off-targets can be estimated with BLAST. Requires working installations of Primer3 and BLASTn.
